name: combobox-17
description: Compose window To field where recipients become chips with initials.

To contact.name} isItemEqualToValue={(a, b) => a.email === b.email} > {(values: Contact[]) => ( {values.map((contact) => ( {initialsOf(contact.name)} {contact.name} ))} )} No contacts found. {(contact: Contact) => (
{contact.name} {contact.email}
)}
